CHAPTER.VERS: A Psalm of Asaph. God stands in the congregation of God; He judges among the gods.
Judge the poor and fatherless: Do justice to the afflicted and destitute.
Rescue the poor and needy: Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.
They don't know, neither do they understand; They walk to and fro in darkness: All the foundations of the earth are shaken.
Arise, O God, judge the earth; For you will inherit all the nations.
